results.title: CAS to hold hearing on Senegal’s AFCON final appeal on October 8
results.description: The Court of Arbitration for Sport (CAS) will hold a hearing to deliver its verdict on Senegal’s appeal against the Confederation of African Football’s (CAF) decision over the 2025 Africa Cup of Nations final on October 8, 2026.
